headline: Cash hogs fell to $36.70 in the Nov. 19 report
lead: Cash hogs fell $2.05 to $36.70 in Thursday's USDA report, the lowest in 71 reports. December futures still rose 2.1%, so the two prices are moving apart.
teaser: Cash hogs fall $2.05 to $36.70 while December hog futures settled at $52.43.

one_number.context: USDA AMS put Thursday's wholesale pork cutout at $68.66, down $0.82 from the day before, so the loss in hogs showed up in pork too.

sections.title: Hogs lower in cash, higher in futures
sections.body:
- December lean hogs settled at **$52.42½**, up 2.1%, while cash hogs fell on a carcass base.
- Packers killed about 494,000 hogs Thursday, against 487,000 a week ago.

sections.title: Grains mixed overnight
sections.body: - December corn is at **$4.37¼** overnight, down 1¾ cents from Thursday's $4.39 settle, and January soybeans are up 4¼ cents to $12.11¾.

outside_the_pit.title: Trump touts Asia deals, but US farm exports lag
outside_the_pit.body: Reuters reported the new Asia trade deals have not yet lifted US farm export sales.

outside_the_pit.title: Crude falls over 5% on oil glut worries
outside_the_pit.body: Oilprice.com reported crude slid as supply grew and US stocks built, which can ease diesel costs.

outside_the_pit.title: Cattle rebound as cutout values slide
outside_the_pit.body: Beef Magazine said live and feeder cattle had strong weekly gains while cash trade stayed cautious.

watch_list.desc: USDA Cattle on Feed and Milk Production reports.

source_summary: CME futures, USDA AMS, NOAA, news wires

natgas.withheld: NG=F moved +10.10% from 3.268 (2026-11-19) to 3.598 (2026-11-20), inside the Dec '26 contract's expiry window (last trade 2026-11-25); the two prices may be different contracts, so the change is withheld

facts.sentence: Basis firmed this week: Ohio soybeans +5¢ (38 of 63 bids moved) and Ohio corn +5¢ (34 of 55).
facts.detail: Each state's middle change in a week, across bids matched with the same elevator's same delivery and futures month; states with 30 or more such bids from 8 or more companies.

theme.headline: Cash hogs fell to $36.70 in the Nov. 19 report
lead: USDA's negotiated cash hog price was $36.70 a hundredweight in the Nov. 19 report, down $2.05 from the report before.
That is the lowest of the 71 reports on file since Aug. 12.
The price covers 2,863 head bought on the spot market in that report; most hogs sell on formulas and contracts.
